title: RESPIRATOR MASK ACCESSORIES – 8247 / R95 Mask / 120/CS
description: 8511 N95 Mask Uniquely designed to help provide protection against certain non-oil particles. Ideally suited for work settings that include heat, humidity or long periods of wear. Features Cool Flow® Exhalation Valve, soft inner materials and adjustable nose clip. 8247 R95 Mask Designed to help provide comfortable protection against certain oil and non-oil based particles includ­ ing those present with nuisance levels of organic vapors such as solvents, degreasers and resins.
